charts.title: TOI-238 b: orbits around TOI-238
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-238's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-238 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Egger et al. 2025 (2025A&A...696A..28E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EGGER_ET_AL__2025): P 1.273099 d

charts.title: TOI-238 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-238 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (29, 69, 96) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 9006668, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
